description: Reviewed input-mass parity exclusions for the UK battery, scoped per reference build (microcosm#1095): each key is the <release>@<build> a cut compared with, and an exclusion suppresses only while that build is the cut's reference, so a promotion leaves it dormant. Each entry is a complete approval receipt (schema-2 fields per #610). The gate reports dormant entries, FAILS stale ones, and FAILS expired ones until the adjudication is renewed. The enhanced-FRS reference's three entries retired with it.
